echo 'CONTEXT RESTORED — Non-negotiables: (1) dotnet build after every change, fix all errors before next file. (2) Never use DisplayAlert/DisplayActionSheet/DisplayPromptAsync. (3) DevExpress-first — check devexpress-patterns.md before any UI work. (4) SafeAreaEdges=Container on all ContentPages (.NET MAUI 10). (5) Subagent-driven, worktree-isolated flow — never skip to implementation: Spec → spec-review → Plan → plan-review → Implement → implementation-review. Each stage AND its review runs in a dedicated subagent (spec-reviewer after the spec, plan-reviewer after the plan, code review after implementation), always inside a git worktree. Two narrow orchestrator lanes replace a dispatch: the read lane (grep + read at most 2 source files to confirm a diagnosis) and the ITF lane for a diagnosed 1-file / <=5-line fix (/sln-itf). (6) English only in code, comments, logs, UI text. (7) After every completed task: /sln-review → /sln-commit (stage, commit, push). SPEC RE-READ REMINDER: After context compaction, re-read the active feature spec (Docs/Management/[BusinessFeatures|DevCycleCraft]/<feature>/design.md and requirements.md) before continuing — compaction discards loaded spec context and continuing without re-reading risks spec drift.'
